metadata.reference: A photorealistic modern office desk next to a window showing a gray overcast sky, with a turned-off desk lamp, a notebook, and a pen holder casting sharp, long directional shadows on the desk as if illuminated by a bright direct sunlight source, photorealistic style, no text or watermarks.
metadata.rationale: The scene shows a cloudy sky and an unlit lamp, yet the objects cast sharp, strong shadows typical of direct midday sun.
